COMPACT VACUUMS

Versatility meets compact design with Makita
®
18V LXT
®
Cordless Compact Vacuums. Ideal for commercial and residential use, Makita offers a range of options for debris disposal and power controls. Makita
®
Stick Vacuums are compact cordless solutions for fast and efficient cleaning, without compromising on performance. Also available 12V max CXT
®
Compact Vacuums.

BENEFITS

FAST CHARGING

A built-in fan circulates air between the charger and battery to cool the battery for faster charge time.

LESS WEIGHT

Makita
®
Compact Vacuums feature a compact design and weigh less for reduced operator fatigue.

EASY STORAGE

Makita�??s Compact Vacuums are compact in size tor easy storage in small closets or cabinets.

LOWER NOISE

The exclusive BL
�?�
Brushless Motor delivers lower sound, minimizing disruption.

MULTIPLE POWER SETTINGS

A push button power controller offers high/normal selection and attaches to the waist.

MOBILITY

Move without restriction from a cord. Onboard cleaning attachments are easy to maneuver to clean hard-to-reach places.

CONVENIENCE

VERSATILITY

Ideal for hard floor, upholstery, vehicle, and short pile carpet.

Great for home, retail, educations, medical, and transportation segments.

EASE-OF-USE

Flat nozzle with ball-and-socket feature for maneuverability and access to hard to reach areas.

Compact design reduces operator fatigue, especially for overhead usage.

CYCLONIC ATTACHMENT

HIGHER-EFFICIENCY CLEANUP
BOOST PERFORMANCE OF A MAKITA
®
COMPACT VACUUM WITH THE MAKITA
®
CYCLONIC VACUUM ATTACHMENT

The Makita
®
Cyclonic Vacuum Attachment is engineered for easy disposal of debris and reduces the amount of dust that enters the vacuum's dust bag.The efficient cyclonic action captures up to 90% of dust particles and increases productivity by reducing the need to empty the main canister/filter.

ONE-TOUCH RELEASE FOR EASY DISPOSAL OF DEBRIS

PREVENTS SUCTION FORCE FROM WEAKENING BY REDUCING THE AMOUNT OF DUST THAT ENTERS THE VACUUM

Extends the overall length of the vacuum

Increases the longevity of the filter and reduces the frequency of emptying the main canister or dust bag by up to 84%

Click system securely attaches to XLC03, XLC04 and XLC05 vacuums (191D72-1 and 191D70-5 only)

Powerful cyclonic action captures up to 90% of dust particles before entering the main canister
